title: Israeli airstrike on Al-Sousi Tower, Gaza City
summary: An Israeli air raid struck a residential apartment in the Al-Sousi Tower in western Gaza City, killing a family of three. It was part of a wider wave of strikes that killed at least 18-19 Palestinians across the enclave that day.

title: Airstrike on Al-Qarara, northwest Khan Younis
summary: An Israeli strike hit an apartment in Al-Qarara, northwest of Khan Younis, killing a married couple and their daughter and wounding three others.

title: Strikes on homes and vehicles near Deir al-Balah
summary: Israeli strikes in the central Gaza town of Deir al-Balah killed an elderly couple in their home and two brothers riding a motorbike in separate incidents.

title: Strikes kill seven, destroy medical warehouse in Gaza
summary: Israeli strikes across Gaza killed at least seven Palestinians and destroyed a medical supply warehouse beside a hospital that officials described as a lifeline for the area.

title: Strikes across Gaza kill at least six, including children
summary: Israeli air strikes hit multiple locations across the Gaza Strip, killing at least six people including children amid continued reported ceasefire violations.

title: Israeli strikes on Khan Younis
summary: Three Palestinians were killed in Israeli strikes targeting the southern city of Khan Younis.

title: Strike near al-Mawasi, southwest Khan Younis
summary: An Israeli strike southwest of the al-Mawasi displacement area near Khan Younis killed three Palestinians and injured several others; a separate strike hit Al-Ghafri Junction in Gaza City.

title: Air strikes kill eight in Gaza, including two children
summary: Israeli air strikes across the Gaza Strip killed eight Palestinians, among them two children.

title: Drone strike on vehicle in Nabatieh al-Fawqa, Lebanon
summary: An Israeli drone struck a car in Nabatieh al-Fawqa in southern Lebanon, killing four people including a school principal and her mother, despite a standing ceasefire.

title: Hezbollah drone attack wounds Israeli soldiers on Lebanon border
summary: A Hezbollah drone attack wounded several Israeli soldiers along the southern Lebanon front, part of continued cross-border exchanges during the 2026 Lebanon war.

title: Hezbollah missile fired toward central Israel
summary: Hezbollah fired a missile toward central Israel that landed in an open area, causing no reported casualties, amid ongoing hostilities across the Israel-Lebanon frontier.

title: Settler raid and shootout in Tal village, near Nablus
summary: Israeli settlers raided the village of Tal southwest of Nablus, triggering a shootout after a Palestinian seized a security officer's weapon; four Palestinians and two Israelis were killed, prompting a wide Israeli military crackdown and mass arrests.

title: Israeli forces kill two Palestinians in Beit Furik, Nablus
summary: Two Palestinians, aged 20 and 16, were shot dead by Israeli forces in Beit Furik near Nablus during a confrontation linked to settler-set fires; two others were wounded.

title: Palestinian killed in Jenin
summary: A 25-year-old Palestinian from Tubas was shot and killed by Israeli soldiers near the Haddad roundabout in Jenin after an alleged stabbing; the army then sealed the area and raided his hometown.

title: Ukrainian missile attack on Belgorod infrastructure
summary: Ukrainian forces struck Belgorod with a large missile barrage, damaging a gas pipeline and the city airport. Local authorities reported one person killed and three injured.

title: Ukrainian naval-drone strikes on Russian tankers in Sea of Azov
summary: Ukraine's Unmanned Systems Forces used FP-2 naval drones to attack Russian fuel tankers ferrying supplies toward Crimea across the Sea of Azov. Multiple vessels were reported struck over several days.

title: Ukrainian drone strike ignites Saratov oil refinery
summary: Long-range Ukrainian drones struck an oil refinery in Saratov, setting the facility ablaze as part of the deep-strike campaign against Russian energy infrastructure.

title: Drone attack on Borisoglebsk air base
summary: Ukrainian drones hit the Borisoglebsk military airfield in Voronezh Oblast, sparking a fire at the base.

title: Ukrainian naval strikes on vessels in Crimean ports
summary: Ukraine's Unmanned Systems Forces reported destroying roughly 18 vessels — including tankers, cargo ships and a ferry — in a wave of naval-drone strikes across occupied Crimean ports.

title: Russian airstrikes on Sumy and Odesa oblasts
summary: Russian air and drone strikes across Sumy and Odesa oblasts killed at least six people, according to Ukrainian officials.

title: Drone strike on Syzran oil refinery
summary: Ukrainian long-range drones set the Syzran oil refinery in Samara Oblast on fire, continuing strikes on Russia's refining capacity.

title: Russian ground advance near Ryasne in northern Sumy Oblast
summary: Geolocated footage indicated Russian forces seized the village of Ryasne and pushed into central Pokrovka southeast of Sumy City, extending their cross-border push into Sumy Oblast.

title: Russian offensive operations north and northeast of Kharkiv
summary: Russian forces continued assaults north and northeast of Kharkiv City aiming to establish a border buffer zone and bring the city within artillery range, but made no confirmed advances, according to ISW.
source_name: Institute for the Study of War (Critical Threats)

title: Nationwide Russian missile and drone barrage; Kryvyi Rih family killed
summary: A Russian overnight barrage of 74 missiles and 284 drones struck cities nationwide, killing at least eight civilians. A single missile hit a house near Kryvyi Rih, killing six members of one family, including three children.
source_name: The Washington Post / The Defense Post

title: SBU drone strikes on Bashkortostan oil refineries
summary: Ukraine's SBU said long-range drones struck three major Bashneft refineries near Ufa — around 1,600 km from the border — one of Russia's largest refining clusters. Radar stations in Krasnodar were also reported hit.

title: Naval drones sink container ship Yanina off Novorossiysk
summary: Ukrainian naval drones sank the sanctioned, Rosatom-affiliated container ship Yanina, of over 100,000 tons capacity, roughly 130 miles from Novorossiysk in the Black Sea.

title: Ukrainian drone strike on warehouse in Moscow region
summary: A Ukrainian drone struck a warehouse in the Moscow region, killing five people and injuring ten, one of several overnight strikes on Russian warehouses including Wildberries sites in Tver and near St. Petersburg.

title: Russian strike on Sumy kills three, including two children
summary: An overnight Russian strike on the northern city of Sumy killed three civilians, among them two children, amid an escalating exchange of long-range attacks.

title: Russian strike on Mykolaiv and its port
summary: Russian forces struck the southern port city of Mykolaiv, killing an elderly woman and hitting seven cargo vessels at the port.

title: Arakan Army and junta clash on three fronts in Kyaukphyu
summary: Roughly a week of intense fighting broke out at three locations around Kyaukphyu Township, including near the Taung Maw Gyi naval station, as the Arakan Army pressed junta positions with heavy weapons. The port town hosts a strategic Chinese-backed deep-sea port and SEZ.

title: Myanmar Navy opens fire on displaced fishermen off Rakhine coast
summary: A junta naval vessel fired on displaced civilians who were fishing off the Rakhine coast near Sittwe, killing one man and wounding another. The incident reflects escalating junta naval and drone operations in southern Rakhine.

title: Over 140 junta airstrikes pound Myaing Township, Magway
summary: The junta carried out more than 140 airstrikes on Myaing Township over six days, peaking on July 27 with over 70 strikes by jet fighters and Y-12 aircraft. At least one resident was injured in an early strike on Nhansarkyin village.
source_name: Burma News International / Myanmar Peace Monitor

title: Junta aircraft drop 40+ bombs on Saw Township, Gangaw District
summary: Two junta aircraft dropped more than 40 bombs on a site in Saw Township, Gangaw District, part of a wider aerial bombardment campaign across Magway Region in late July.

title: Helicopter bombing kills civilians in Kan Yin village, Ayadaw
summary: Three junta helicopters bombed Kan Yin village in Ayadaw Township, killing a pregnant woman, her unborn child, and another woman, and critically injuring a man. It was part of July 13-14 air raids across Sagaing and Magway.

title: KNLA and junta battle south of Myawaddy in Karen State
summary: The junta rotated in fresh troops from Light Infantry Divisions 22 and the Coastal Region Command to renew offensives in KNU Brigade 6 territory south of Myawaddy, backed by artillery and airstrikes. The KNLA reported 133 clashes in July, with dozens of junta soldiers killed.

title: Heavy clashes near Nam Hpar village outside Bhamo
summary: Fighting flared near Nam Hpar village outside Bhamo as reinforced junta troops launched an airstrike-backed counteroffensive to retake KIA-held ground, forcing the Kachin Independence Army to pull back from some positions.

title: Ongoing KIA-junta clashes in Waingmaw Township
summary: Fighting continued around Waingmaw Township as the junta pressed a counteroffensive to break the KIA's hold near Myitkyina, using ground troops, artillery and air support along routes toward rare-earth mining hubs.

title: Junta drone strike kills five civilians in Hpruso, Karenni
summary: A junta drone dropped two bombs on a residential area of western Hpruso Township, killing five civilians including a five-month-old infant, in the second such drone assault in two days.

title: TNLA and junta sign ceasefire commitment in Naypyidaw
summary: A Ta'ang National Liberation Army delegation met the junta's peace negotiating committee in Naypyidaw and signed an agreement reaffirming a China-brokered ceasefire, easing one of the northern Shan fronts.

title: Junta announces two-month halt to military operations
summary: The junta announced it would suspend military activities for two months through August and September, though resistance groups reported airstrikes and drone attacks continued into early August.

title: SAF recaptures strategic border town of Kurmuk in Blue Nile
summary: The Sudanese Armed Forces retook Kurmuk after fierce street-by-street fighting, ending more than three months of control by the RSF and allied SPLM-N (al-Hilu) fighters, who retreated toward Yabus and into Ethiopia. The town anchors a key supply corridor from Ethiopia toward Ad Damazin.

title: RSF captures Kulbus in West Darfur after SAF withdrawal
summary: RSF forces amassing near Kulbus seized the town following a Sudanese army withdrawal, prompting residents to flee. The gain consolidated RSF control across the West Darfur borderlands.

title: SAF air defenses down RSF strategic drone near El Obeid
summary: The Sudanese army shot down a Chinese-made long-range RSF drone northwest of the North Kordofan capital El Obeid, part of intensifying air activity over the state ahead of ground offensives.

title: Drone strike on water hub kills 21 in Tine, North Darfur
summary: A suspected RSF drone struck a water distribution point in Tine near the Chad border, killing at least 21 people and wounding more than 30. The army moved reinforcements into the area afterward.

title: SAF launches major North Kordofan offensive, captures Bara
summary: After a months-long lull, the army and allied units launched a three-axis offensive taking Bara, Um Sayyala and Jabrat al-Sheikh from the RSF. The advance reopened the strategic road linking North Kordofan to Khartoum.

title: SAF secures El Obeid-Omdurman 'Export road' supply corridor
summary: Following its Bara offensive, the army declared full control of the vital highway linking El Obeid to Omdurman, restoring a key logistics artery between the capital and Kordofan. The RSF responded by granting field commanders greater autonomy.

title: Retreating RSF raids civilians at Umm Badr amid SAF drone strikes
summary: RSF units pulling back from Bara and Jabrat al-Sheikh looted markets, raided homes and detained residents in Umm Badr, Sodari and Hamrat al-Sheikh, while the army struck retreating RSF convoys with drones.

title: Heavy SAF airstrike wave hits RSF across North and West Kordofan
summary: In one of the war's most intense aerial escalations, Sudanese warplanes and strategic drones hit RSF concentrations from Umm Badr and Sodari in the north to Al-Khuwei and En Nahud in West Kordofan. The strikes followed the army's ground gains around Bara.

title: Alleged SAF drone strike on court gathering kills 37 in Kabkabiya
summary: An alleged army drone strike hit a customary court gathering in the RSF-held Kabkabiya district of North Darfur, reportedly killing 37 people and wounding around 40, including RSF commanders and tribal figures.

title: China Coast Guard strikes Philippine marine with baton off Second Thomas Shoal
region: South China Sea (Second Thomas Shoal / Ayungin)
summary: A China Coast Guard rigid-hull inflatable crew approached the grounded BRP Sierra Madre and, in a close-quarters confrontation with Philippine Navy boats, a Chinese crewman struck a Filipino marine on the head with a wooden baton, injuring him. Both sides filed protests, each accusing the other of ramming.

title: Chinese coast guard fires water cannon at Philippine vessel near Scarborough Shoal
region: South China Sea (Scarborough Shoal / Bajo de Masinloc)
summary: A China Coast Guard ship fired a water cannon and used dangerous maneuvers against a Philippine vessel supporting fishermen near Scarborough Shoal, part of a multi-day escalation after Beijing warned Manila of consequences. Manila and Beijing traded accusations over the clash.

title: China stages military and coast guard drills near Scarborough Shoal
summary: China conducted joint military and coast guard exercises, including two warships, near the contested Scarborough Shoal as a show of force following the late-July clashes with the Philippines.

title: Philippines, US and Japan hold 17th Multilateral Maritime Cooperative Activity in South China Sea
region: West Philippine Sea / South China Sea
summary: The Philippines, United States and Japan ran a five-day trilateral naval and air exercise (July 21-25) within the Philippine EEZ, deploying warships, coast guard vessels and fighter aircraft amid escalating friction with China at disputed features.

title: PLA holds two-day live-fire drill off Dongshan Island facing Taiwan
summary: The PLA conducted a two-day live-fire exercise in waters east and south of Dongshan Island in Fujian, opposite Taiwan, a coercive signal analysts linked to President Lai's July 19 speech.

title: Chinese research ship surveys Taiwan's exclusive economic zone
actors: PRC East China Sea Fisheries Research Institute
summary: The PRC research vessel Lanhai 201 carried out a week-long fisheries survey inside Taiwan's exclusive economic zone east of the island, part of Beijing's effort to assert jurisdiction over the surrounding waters.

title: PLA helicopter crosses Taiwan Strait median line in new gray-zone tactic
summary: A PLA helicopter crossed the Taiwan Strait median line, which analysts described as a novel gray-zone tactic to normalize military presence and pressure Taipei's response thresholds.

title: Taiwan detects PLA aircraft and warships, three crossing median line into ADIZ
summary: Taiwan's defense ministry detected five PLA aircraft, eight PLAN vessels and two official Chinese ships around the island, with three aircraft crossing the median line into the southwestern ADIZ; Taiwan responded with combat air patrols, ships and coastal missile systems.

title: PLA aircraft and naval vessels operate around Taiwan
summary: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense reported PLA aircraft and naval vessels operating in the waters and airspace around Taiwan, with sorties crossing the median line and entering the ADIZ, part of near-daily incursions.

title: North Korea fires salvo of around 10 ballistic missiles toward East Sea
region: East Sea / Sea of Japan (approx. launch area)
summary: North Korea launched a salvo of roughly 10 short-range ballistic missiles toward the East Sea, its first ballistic missile test since January; South Korea's JCS assessed it as an effort to diversify strike packages harder for Seoul to intercept.

title: North Korea launches cruise missiles toward the East Sea
summary: South Korea's military detected North Korea firing cruise missiles toward the East Sea, with Seoul and Washington analyzing the launch as part of Pyongyang's broadening land- and sea-launched missile program.

title: Point Zéro 요새 함락 (이톰브웨 산악)
summary: M23/AFC-M23와 동맹 트위르와네호(Twirwaneho) 무장세력이 미넴브웨 동쪽 약 24km 이톰브웨 산악의 전략 거점 Point Zéro를 점령했다. 방어하던 FARDC·부룬디군(FDNB)·와잘렌도가 무탐발라·무케라 방향으로 후퇴했다.

title: 미넴브웨 고지대 부룬디군 진지 드론 공격
summary: 남키부 고지대에서 부룬디 방위군(FDNB) 진지가 드론 공습을 받은 것으로 지역 보도가 전했다. Point Zéro 상실 직후 이어진 공격으로 정확한 피해 규모는 확인되지 않았다.

title: FARDC, 피지·음웽가·우비라 고지대 대(對)M23 공세
summary: 콩고군이 피지·음웽가·우비라 고지대에서 AFC/M23 반군을 상대로 공세를 지속했다. 2026년 1월 M23의 우비라 철수 이후 고지대가 교전의 중심지가 됐다.

title: 말레모·응킹웨 마을 쟁탈전 (피지 북부)
summary: M23가 피지 지역 진지를 공격했다고 주장한 뒤 FARDC와 와잘렌도가 말레모 마을과 인근 응킹웨 거점을 장악했다. 미넴브웨 북부 일대에서 공방이 이어졌다.

title: DRC, 카부무 공항 통한 르완다군 공수 증원 주장
summary: 콩고 국방부 부총리가 르완다군이 부카부 북쪽 카부무 공항을 통해 남키부 고지대에 병력을 공수 증원하고 정부군 진지에 공격 드론 사용을 늘렸다고 주장했다.

title: 트위르와네호, 피지·음웽가 마을 점령
summary: M23 동맹 트위르와네호 병력이 피지·음웽가 territory에서 여러 마을을 추가로 점령했다. 고지대 전선의 M23 측 진격이 계속됐다.

title: FARDC·와잘렌도, 미넴브웨 북부 마을 탈환
summary: FARDC와 와잘렌도가 피지 미넴브웨 북쪽의 한 마을을 M23 측으로부터 탈환했다. 고지대 마을을 둘러싼 반복적 공방의 일부였다.

title: EJVM+ 첫 회의, FARDC 장교 고마 방문
summary: MONUSCO 부단장이 FARDC 장교 3명을 대동해 고마에서 M23 측과 첫 확대공동검증기구(EJVM+) 회의를 열었다. 2025년 1월 M23의 고마 함락 이후 FARDC가 처음으로 고마를 방문한 사례다.

title: 마시시-왈리칼레 접경 RP1030 도로 교전
summary: 북키부 마시시-왈리칼레 접경 RP1030 도로 일대에서 M23와 친정부 와잘렌도 병력이 교전했다. M23는 이 축선 진지를 강화하며 서진 압박을 지속했다.

title: M23, 이훌라·말레모 진지 병력·탄약 증강
summary: M23가 왈리칼레·마시시 지역 이훌라와 말레모 마을 진지에 병력과 탄약을 증강 배치했다고 보고됐다. RP1030 축선을 따라 전열을 재정비하는 움직임이었다.

title: ADF, 맘바사 territory 민간인 학살 (은지아판다-벨라 등)
summary: 이투리 맘바사 territory 만지아·카자로호·마콩고 및 광산 마을 은지아판다-벨라에서 ADF로 추정되는 공격으로 최소 27명이 살해되고 11명이 실종됐다. 광산 마을에서만 약 18명이 숨졌다.

title: 동부 DRC 지하디스트 공격 최소 20명 사망
summary: 동부 DRC 베니 일대에서 ADF와 연계된 지하디스트 공격으로 최소 20명이 숨졌다. FARDC가 M23 대응에 재배치되며 생긴 안보 공백을 ADF가 파고들었다.

title: M23, 탄추(Tchanzu) 훈련소서 9,318명 신규 '코만도' 편성
summary: M23가 북키부 루츠루의 탄추 주훈련소에서 수개월 훈련을 마친 9,318명의 '코만도' 임관식을 열었다고 발표했다. 9,000명 이상 신규 병력을 대열에 통합했다는 주장이다.

title: Houthi ground assault kills 16 government troops near Hodeidah
summary: Houthi forces launched a coordinated assault on government positions in the Jabal Dabbas area of Hays district, south of Hodeidah, killing 16 pro-government troops in the fiercest fighting in years. Yemeni officials said more than 50 Houthi fighters also died in the clashes.

title: Cargo ship attacked southwest of Hodeidah in Red Sea
summary: A bulk carrier reported coming under small-arms fire from a skiff about 30 nautical miles southwest of Hodeidah, per UK Maritime Trade Operations. The vessel and crew were reported safe.

title: Yemeni government strikes Sanaa airport runway to block Iranian flight
summary: Yemen's internationally recognized government said it struck the runway of Houthi-held Sanaa International Airport to prevent a Mahan Air flight from Iran, carrying a returning Houthi delegation, from landing. The plane diverted to Hodeidah.

title: Houthis strike Saudi Arabia's Abha airport with missiles and drones
summary: In retaliation for the Sanaa airport strike, Houthi forces fired ballistic missiles and drones at Abha International Airport, declaring an end to the de-escalation phase. Saudi air defenses intercepted the missiles with no casualties reported.

title: Houthis declare naval blockade of Saudi Arabia
summary: The Houthis declared an immediate maritime blockade on Saudi shipping between the Red Sea and Gulf of Aden, in response to what they called a Saudi siege on Yemen. The move threatened traffic through the strategic Bab el-Mandeb chokepoint.

title: Renewed clashes between Houthis and government forces in Hudaydah
summary: Fighting resumed along frozen frontlines in the Hudaydah governorate between Houthi and internationally recognized government forces, extending the collapse of the de facto truce that had held since 2022.

title: Houthis attack two Saudi oil tankers near Bab el-Mandeb
summary: Houthi forces struck two Saudi oil tankers, the Encelia and Layla, with ballistic and cruise missiles and drones for allegedly violating the blockade, causing fires aboard. Red Sea traffic through Bab el-Mandeb fell sharply as tankers rerouted.

title: Saudi-led coalition airstrikes on Houthi-held Hodeidah
summary: Saudi airstrikes hit Houthi military sites in Hodeidah governorate linked to Red Sea shipping attacks, triggering powerful explosions in the port city. The Houthis vowed to meet escalation with escalation.

title: Saudi airstrike on Kamaran Island
summary: As part of the coalition strikes on the Hodeidah area, telecommunications facilities on Kamaran Island off Yemen's Red Sea coast were hit, with Houthi-aligned media reporting one woman injured.

title: Houthi missile and drone strike burns Aramco Jizan refinery
summary: Houthi forces struck the Saudi Aramco Jizan refinery complex near the Yemeni border with dozens of missiles and drones, damaging its integrated gasification powerplant and a tank farm. The 400,000 bpd plant was shut down for repairs into mid-August.

title: Houthi strike on Aramco facilities at Yanbu
summary: In the same coordinated operation, Houthi forces claimed missile and drone strikes on Saudi Aramco-affiliated facilities at the Red Sea port of Yanbu, framed as retaliation for coalition strikes on Hodeidah and Kamaran Island.

title: Houthi ballistic missile attack on Saudi tanker NCC Ghazal
summary: Houthi forces fired several ballistic missiles at the Saudi oil tanker NCC Ghazal for allegedly violating the maritime ban, causing an explosion as it transited the Red Sea. UKMTO said the crew was safe with no environmental damage.

title: Anéfis 6일 공방전 (FLA·JNIM vs FAMA·아프리카군단)
summary: FLA와 JNIM 연합 세력이 7월 4일 드론·포병·장갑차를 동원해 북부 요충지 Anéfis 군기지를 급습, 6일간의 격전 끝에 말리군은 7월 10일 탈환을 발표했으나 병사 약 30명이 전사했다. 키달 지역 통제권을 둘러싼 2012년 반란 이후 최장기 지속 교전 중 하나였다.

title: Gao 시 군기지 습격 (7·4 다전선 공세)
summary: JNIM·FLA가 7월 4일 북부 전역 동시 공세의 일환으로 가오 시 군기지를 공격했으나 말리군과 러시아 아프리카군단이 격퇴했다. 같은 날 Anéfis·Aguelhok 등 여러 기지가 동시에 표적이 됐다.

title: Aguelhok 군기지 습격 (7·4 공세)
summary: 7월 4일 북부 동시 공세에서 키달 지역 Aguelhok 기지도 JNIM·FLA의 공격을 받았으나 말리군·아프리카군단이 방어에 성공했다.

title: Tabankort 인근 군 호송대 매복 습격
summary: 7월 18일 JNIM과 FLA가 Anéfis에서 가오로 이동하던 말리군·아프리카군단 호송대를 Tabankort 부근에서 정교하게 매복 습격해 다수의 병사를 사살하거나 생포했다. 말리군은 정밀 반격으로 호송대를 매복에서 이탈시켰다고 주장했다.

title: Téra 군 주둔지 테러 습격 (병사 16명 전사)
summary: 7월 17일 말리·부르키나파소 접경의 Téra 지역 군 배치를 겨냥한 무장세력 공격으로 병사 16명이 전사하고 23명이 부상했으며, 니제르군은 무장세력 15명을 사살했다고 밝혔다.

title: Di 군기지 습격 (병사·VDP 21명 사망)
summary: 7월 5일 토요일 새벽 Dédougou 인근 Di 군기지가 JNIM으로 추정되는 세력에 습격당해 군인 약 14명과 민간 방위의용군(VDP) 7명이 사망했다. JNIM은 부르키나파소군 진지 공격을 자처했다.

title: Solhan 공격
summary: 7월 5~6일 주말 사헬 지역 Solhan에서 JNIM 추정 세력의 공격으로 인적·물적 손실이 발생했다. 같은 주말 부르키나파소 여러 지점에서 동시다발 공격이 이어졌다.

title: Séguénéga 군 초소 습격
summary: 7월 6일 일요일 Kaya 인근 북부 Séguénéga의 군 초소가 JNIM 추정 무장세력의 공격을 받았다. 주말 연쇄 공격 중 세 번째 표적이었다.

title: 6·30 JNIM 동시 공세 (Makalondi·Torodi·Diagourou)
summary: 6월 30일 JNIM이 니제르 Makalondi·Torodi·Diagourou를 동시 공격했으며, Diagourou를 제외한 대부분은 격퇴됐다. 같은 날 부르키나파소 국경지대까지 아우르는 국경 초월 조율 공세였다.

title: 6·30 JNIM 동시 공세 (Sebba·Solhan·Gayeri)
summary: 6월 30일 JNIM이 부르키나파소 Sebba·Solhan·Gayeri를 니제르 표적과 동시에 공격했다. 부르키나파소 당국은 이 조율 공세에서 무장세력 최소 400명을 사살했다고 주장했다.

title: Suicide bombing at anti-militant rally in Kabal, Swat
summary: A suicide bomber struck an anti-militant peace rally in the town of Kabal in Swat Valley, killing at least 14 people, mostly civilians and police, and wounding more than two dozen. Suspicion fell on the Pakistani Taliban (TTP).

title: TTP assault on police post in Hangu
summary: TTP fighters used explosive-laden quadcopters before ambushing a police post in Hangu district near the Afghan border, killing around 9-11 officers including a DSP. Security forces killed about 15 attackers in the retaliation.

title: North Waziristan counter-terror operation
summary: In an intelligence-based operation in North Waziristan, Pakistani security forces killed five militants while an army major was killed in the exchange of fire. Weapons and ammunition were recovered from the site.

title: Taliban-Pakistan border clash along Durand Line, Nangarhar
summary: Afghan Taliban and Pakistani border forces exchanged fire with light and heavy weapons in the Durba district area of Nangarhar province and near Zakha Khel, the latest flare-up in the ongoing Durand Line border dispute.

title: Coordinated BLA/TTP attacks across Balochistan
summary: A wave of coordinated insurgent assaults on convoys, checkpoints and supply routes across multiple Balochistan districts killed 42 people, including 38 security personnel. Pakistan's military blamed joint TTP and Baloch Liberation Army operations.

title: Pakistani air and helicopter counter-insurgency operations in Balochistan
summary: Following the coordinated insurgent attacks, Pakistani forces launched counter-operations with air and helicopter support, reporting around 75 militants killed across Balochistan, including in the Kharan and Dalbandin areas.

title: Cross-border firing along LoC in Rajouri-Poonch
summary: Indian troops opened fire after detecting suspicious movement near the Line of Control in the Tarkundi forward area of Rajouri, triggering an exchange of small-arms and machine-gun fire with Pakistani troops over several days. No casualties were reported.

title: Pakistani airstrikes on eastern Afghanistan border regions
summary: Pakistani airstrikes on border areas of eastern Afghanistan, described by Islamabad as retaliation for cross-border attacks, killed roughly 28 civilians and wounded dozens, drawing civilian-casualty concerns from rights groups.

title: Afghan Taliban retaliatory airstrikes near Chaman, Balochistan
summary: Afghanistan's defence ministry said its forces launched retaliatory airstrikes on what it called an ISIS center in Saranan near Chaman in Pakistan's Balochistan; Pakistan said it intercepted and shot down several rudimentary drones over the province.

title: TTP 'Operation Khyber' multi-target strikes in KP tribal districts
summary: The Pakistani Taliban announced a fresh batch of eight attacks under its 'Operation Khyber' campaign, targeting security posts across Khyber Pakhtunkhwa's tribal rim including Tank, North and South Waziristan and the Malakand Division.

title: Provincial Apex Committee vows anti-terror crackdown in Quetta
summary: After the surge of Balochistan violence, Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif chaired the Provincial Apex Committee on the National Action Plan in Quetta, announcing a joint civil-military decision to escalate counter-terrorism operations across the province.

title: Gunmen massacre at least 30 in Kaduna's Naridon village
summary: Gunmen stormed Naridon village in Kaduna's Kaura council late at night, shooting randomly and burning houses, killing at least 30 people including eight children. No group claimed responsibility.

title: Herdsmen raid kills 16 at Otukpo-Nobi, Benue
summary: Suspected armed herdsmen attacked Otukpo-Nobi community around 4am, killing at least 16 people during a wave of raids on farming communities in Benue's Otukpo area.

title: Night attack kills nine of one family in Riyom, Plateau
summary: Attackers struck the Kum and Wereng-Camp communities in Riyom around 11:30pm, killing nine members of one family including a two-month-old baby and critically wounding the village head.

title: Herdsmen kill three in Guma, Benue
summary: Suspected herdsmen invaded Abaushwa community in Guma around 11:30pm, killing a father, his son and daughter and injuring others.

title: Over 200 bandits attack Guga village, Katsina; 40+ killed in battle
actors: Bandits (Idi Abasu Aiki / Ado Aleru groups)
summary: More than 200 heavily armed bandits stormed Guga village in Bakori in a reprisal raid; security forces and local defenders repelled them, killing over 40 attackers in a fierce gun battle.

title: Bandits kill woman, abduct resident in Patigi, Kwara
summary: Suspected bandits raided the Lata Nna community in Patigi, killing a woman and abducting another resident, prompting villagers to flee.

title: Troops repel ISWAP assault on Logomani base, Borno
summary: Operation Hadin Kai troops repelled an ISWAP attack on a forward operating base at Logomani, killing six insurgents and wounding several before survivors withdrew.

title: Separatist commander 'General No Mercy' killed in Bambalang, Cameroon
summary: Government forces killed Henry Njimbogwe, alias 'General No Mercy,' leader of the Bambalang Marine Forces and Bui Unity Warriors, in the Anglophone North-West region.

title: Separatists kill business owner in Bali, Cameroon
summary: Armed separatist fighters carried out a targeted killing in Bali, shooting dead a local business owner and wounding two other people.

title: Militia leader 'General Sagat' killed by BIR in Fako, Cameroon
summary: Cameroon's Rapid Intervention Brigade killed 'Major General Sagat,' leader of the Fako Mountain Lions separatist militia, in the Fako division of the South-West region.

title: Gunmen attack football match in Eyumodjock, Cameroon
summary: Armed separatist fighters attacked a football match in Eyumodjock, executing a match official and abducting three other people.

title: JNIM massacres 14 civilians in Youba, Burkina Faso
summary: JNIM fighters attacked Youba village in Burkina Faso's North region, killing 14 civilians including four children, reportedly to punish the community for not complying with the group's orders.

title: IS Sahel attacks escorted convoy near Gorom-Gorom, Burkina Faso
summary: Islamic State Sahel Province attacked a civilian convoy escorted by Burkinabe soldiers and VDP auxiliaries near Gorom-Gorom, killing at least nine civilians.

title: Iran-linked cyberattack disrupts Minnesota municipal water systems
summary: A coordinated cyberattack hit roughly 36 Minnesota municipal water utilities over July 26-27, forcing Plymouth and South St. Paul to switch to manual operation and prompting a local emergency in Maple Plain. US investigators preliminarily attributed the intrusion to Iranian state-linked hackers; drinking water was confirmed unaffected.

title: Pro-Iran hacktivists strike Israeli and Jordanian infrastructure
summary: Amid the July collapse of the Iran ceasefire, a decentralized network of pro-Iran hacktivist groups (including Handala Hack and the Cyber Islamic Resistance coalition) intensified DDoS, defacement and hack-and-leak operations against Israeli energy firms, Jordanian fuel systems and Western-aligned targets. Impact was largely disruptive and psychological rather than destructive.

title: US House panel details China's Salt Typhoon telecom espionage
summary: A US House committee reported that the Chinese state-linked Salt Typhoon operation exploited data-center and carrier infrastructure to maintain deep, persistent access across major US telecom networks, enabling location tracking and interception. The disclosure widened the known victim list and underscored continuing network vulnerability.

title: Vehicle-ramming attack on Berlin Pride march
summary: A man drove a van into crowds during Berlin's Christopher Street Day pride celebration, killing one woman and injuring 29. The attack was assessed as homophobically motivated; the attacker died after charging police with a knife.

title: TTP-BLA joint assaults on security posts in Balochistan
summary: A wave of coordinated militant attacks the Pakistani military attributed to the TTP and Balochistan Liberation Army struck posts around Ziarat, Quetta and Lasbela in early July, including the overrun of the Mangi checkpoint where 27 police were killed. Retaliatory operations killed scores of militants, making July Pakistan's deadliest month of 2026.

title: JNIM-FLA siege of Anefis military camp, northern Mali
summary: Beginning July 4, JNIM and allied FLA fighters launched simultaneous assaults on bases at Gao, Aguelhok and Anefis, with the heaviest fighting encircling the Anefis camp for days against Malian troops and Russian Africa Corps. The army claimed over 300 insurgents killed after dozens of airstrikes between July 6 and 8.

title: US airstrike targets al-Shabaab near Jamaame, Somalia
summary: US Africa Command conducted an airstrike against al-Shabaab in the vicinity of Jamaame, about 58 km northeast of Kismayo, part of a sustained US counterterrorism campaign against the al-Qaeda affiliate amid its territorial resurgence in southern Somalia.

title: US airstrike on al-Shabaab near Qumbi, southern Somalia
summary: AFRICOM struck al-Shabaab militants in the vicinity of Qumbi, roughly 88 km northwest of Kismayo, one of several July strikes supporting Somali forces resisting the group's offensive in previously liberated areas.

title: Nigerian troops foil ISWAP/Boko Haram mass abduction in Borno
summary: Nigerian Operation Hadin Kai troops intercepted a suspected Boko Haram/ISWAP mass-abduction attempt along the Buratai-Kamuya road in Biu LGA, rescuing 31 travellers and recovering four vehicles. The foiled attack followed the army's July 23 killing of a senior ISWAP figure and reflected intensifying jihadist activity across the northeast.

title: ISIS Sahel Province and JNIM contest western Niger
summary: Western Niger's Tillaberi region became the main battleground of an intensifying turf war between the Islamic State Sahel Province and JNIM through July, with both groups escalating attacks on military positions and civilians to consolidate influence following large-scale June raids on army camps.

title: Israeli drone strike on Tebnine kills one, wounds 11
summary: An Israeli drone struck the roof of a prayer hall at the Tebnine town cemetery, killing one person and wounding 11, as Lebanese and Israeli officials held a second day of implementation talks in Rome.

title: Israeli strike on ambulance in Nabatieh al-Fawqa wounds medics
summary: An Israeli strike hit an ambulance in Nabatieh al-Fawqa, injuring two medics, part of continuing Israeli attacks in the south despite a US-brokered ceasefire framework.

title: Israeli demolition blasts in Majdal Zoun and al-Mansouri
summary: Israeli forces detonated large blasts while leveling structures in the border villages of Majdal Zoun and al-Mansouri; the Majdal Zoun explosion was heard as far as Tyre, over 15 km away.

title: US-Saudi airstrikes hit PMF headquarters in Baghdad
summary: Coordinated US and Saudi airstrikes struck Iran-aligned Popular Mobilization Forces sites across seven provinces, killing at least 20 fighters and several IRGC advisers; Iraq condemned the operation as a violation of its sovereignty.

title: US-Saudi strikes hit PMF weapons sites in Nineveh
summary: As part of the same multi-province operation, US and Saudi aircraft struck PMF logistics hubs and weapons stores in Nineveh, one of seven provinces hit in the overnight campaign against Iran-backed groups.

title: Iranian drones hit PAK camp near Erbil (Darashakran)
summary: Three explosive-laden drones struck the Kurdistan Freedom Party (PAK) camp in the Darashakran area west of Erbil within minutes of each other, causing no casualties in one round of Iran's cross-border campaign against Iranian-Kurdish opposition groups.

title: Iranian strike kills nine Komala fighters near Sulaymaniyah
summary: Drones and rockets attributed to Iran hit a Komala (Iranian Kurdish opposition) camp near Sulaymaniyah at dawn, killing nine members and wounding two more at another camp in the biggest escalation since an April ceasefire.

title: Drones launched from Iraq intercepted en route to Saudi oil sites
summary: Saudi air defenses intercepted drones launched from Iraqi territory toward oil facilities in the kingdom's Eastern Province; the attacks, blamed on Iran-aligned Iraqi militias, triggered the July 29 US-Saudi strikes.

title: Latakia security operation kills two coastal-attack suspects
summary: Syria's Internal Security Command said an operation in Latakia killed two men and arrested a third suspected of bombings and attacks on security forces and army positions in the tense coastal region.

title: Renewed clashes and kidnappings destabilize Sweida
summary: Security in southern Syria's Sweida continued to deteriorate through late July with recurring Druze-Bedouin and intra-Druze clashes, tit-for-tat kidnappings, and organized crime a year after the 2025 sectarian bloodshed.

title: 알샤바브, 히란주 요충지 티단(Teedaan) 장악
summary: 알샤바브가 약 24시간 교전 끝에 정부군과 지역 민병대를 몰아내고 히란주 전략 요충지 티단을 장악했다. 이 지역은 히란과 갈구두드·중부 셰벨레를 잇는 주요 도로에 위치해 무장세력의 이동·과세 통제에 유리하다.

title: 미 아프리콤, 키스마요 북서부 쿰비 알샤바브 공습
summary: 미 아프리카사령부가 소말리아 연방정부와 공조해 키스마요 북서쪽 약 88km 쿰비 인근 알샤바브 목표물을 공습했다. 소말리아 국군 작전을 지원하는 일련의 공습 중 하나다.

title: 미 아프리콤, 하부 셰벨레 사블랄레 알샤바브 공습
summary: 미 아프리콤이 모가디슈 남서쪽 약 190km 사블랄레 인근에서 알샤바브를 겨냥한 공습을 실시했다. 소말리아 정부와의 공조 작전으로 발표됐다.

title: 미 아프리콤, 키스마요 북부 웰마로 알샤바브 공습
summary: 미 아프리콤이 키스마요 북쪽 약 100km 웰마로 인근 알샤바브 목표물을 공습했다. 소말리아 국군의 대알샤바브 작전을 지원하는 일환이다.

title: 미 아프리콤, 키스마요 북동부 자마메 알샤바브 공습
summary: 미 아프리콤이 키스마요 북동쪽 약 58km 자마메 인근에서 알샤바브를 겨냥한 공습을 실시했다고 8월 3일 발표했다. 소말리아 연방정부와의 공조 작전이다.

title: 소말리아 정보군, 히란주 야간작전서 알샤바브 15명 사살
summary: 소말리아 정보기관 특수부대가 히란주에서 실시한 야간 작전으로 알샤바브 대원 약 15명을 사살했다고 발표했다. 중부 지역 알샤바브 공세에 맞선 정부군 반격의 일부다.

title: 소말리아 대통령, 알샤바브 상대 신규 대공세 발표
summary: 하산 셰이크 모하무드 대통령이 알샤바브를 소말리아 안보의 중대 위협으로 규정하며 새로운 대공세 계획을 밝혔다. 무장세력이 중부 지역에서 세력을 확대하는 가운데 나온 조치다.

title: 에티오피아군-TPLF, 서티그라이 셰레리나서 교전 재개
summary: 티그라이 지역군과 에티오피아 연방군이 수단 국경 인근 서티그라이 셰레리나에서 중포와 드론을 동원한 교전을 벌였다. 2022년 프리토리아 평화협정 이후 최대 규모의 충돌로, 수백 명의 민간인이 수단으로 피신했다.

title: 남월로 보레나-사인트 수도원 드론 공습, 수녀 등 민간인 사상
summary: 남월로 보레나-사인트 워레다에서 에티오피아 정교회 소속 수도원을 겨냥한 드론 공습으로 수녀를 포함한 민간인 사상자가 발생했다. 암하라 지역 파노-정부군 무력분쟁 격화 속 발생한 사건이다.

title: 곤데르 지역서 파노-정부군 교전 지속
summary: 7월 20~26일 중부·북부 곤데르(동뎀비아, 자나모라 등) 여러 워레다에서 파노 자위대와 정부 합동군 간 전투 및 인권침해가 기록됐다. 암하라 8개 존 23개 이상 행정구역에서 교전이 이어졌다.

title: 동고잠 곤차 일대 파노 공격, 민병·경찰 22명 사망
summary: 파노 테워드로스 사령부 201군단이 동고잠 곤차-시소-에네세 일대 군데 웨이네 인근에서 작전을 벌여 케모·부자 마을 주둔 민병·경찰을 공격했다. 파노 측은 22명 사살, 20명 부상을 주장했다.

title: 에티오피아군, 고잠·남곤데르 작전서 '파노 230명 무력화' 주장
summary: 에티오피아군이 고잠과 남곤데르 일대 작전에서 파노 전투원 약 230명을 '무력화'했다고 주장했다. 암하라 지역 무장분쟁이 지속되는 가운데 나온 발표로 독립적 확인은 어렵다.

title: 남티그라이 라야-알라마타서 TPLF의 주민 체포·납치
summary: 티그라이-암하라 접경 라야-알라마타 및 곤차-시소-에네세 워레다에서 TPLF 병력에 의한 주민 체포·납치가 보고됐다. 티그라이-연방 간 긴장이 고조되던 시기에 발생했다.

title: Village de Dieu gang massacre in Kenscoff and Pétion-Ville
summary: Viv Ansanm-linked gunmen (Village de Dieu) assaulted the hillside communes of Kenscoff and Pétion-Ville over July 4-9, killing at least 61 residents including 14 children and burning homes. The IOM recorded roughly 5,840 people displaced from the affected localities.

title: ELN explosive-drone strike on Arenal police station
summary: ELN operatives attacked the police station in Arenal, southern Bolívar, with explosive-laden drones, wounding three officers and destroying the facility. The strike cut electricity to the area and reflected the guerrillas' growing use of weaponized UAVs.

title: Los Mayos cartel killings across Zacatecas
summary: Ten people, including a former mayor, public servants and ranchers, were killed across three Zacatecas municipalities, most by asphyxiation, with five bodies hung from a bridge near Pánuco. A Sinaloa Cartel faction, Los Mayos, claimed responsibility in a video days later.

title: Gangs seize Port-au-Prince main port amid GSF operations
summary: Viv Ansanm gangs tightened their grip on Port-au-Prince, seizing control of the capital's main port as the UN-backed Gang Suppression Force pressed continuous patrols and operations against gang infrastructure. A US envoy described the capital as a gang 'kill zone' in a Security Council briefing.

title: ELN truck bomb outside Cúcuta police base
summary: A truck packed with explosives detonated next to a National Police base in Cúcuta near the Venezuelan border, injuring eleven people (eight officers and three civilians). The government blamed the ELN; the blast came days before the presidential inauguration.

title: Assassinations of local officials in Ecuador's coastal provinces
summary: Gang-linked gunmen assassinated a district authority in El Oro province on July 8 and a Public Prosecutor's Office official in Santa Elena on July 10, part of a surge in targeted killings of state and local officials. ICG logged the coastal provinces under a state of emergency amid record civilian violence.

title: Gang violence surge in Manabí province
summary: Manabí, a Los Choneros stronghold, saw at least 20 people killed across several cities as rival factions fought for control of Pacific trafficking routes, contributing to a monthly high in gang violence against civilians. Portoviejo and surrounding towns were among the hardest hit.
source_name: ACLED Latin America & Caribbean Overview: July 2026
